subject: Fix incorrect laddr field and correct getClientSockname declaration (#2214)
reason: The change only fixes the laddr argument passed to an LTTng tracepoint (valkey_commands_trace in call()), renames tracepoint fields, corrects a function-prototype casing mismatch in server.h, and updates the trace README. None of this affects command replies, CLIENT INFO/LIST output, replication, persistence, or any state the fuzzer's oracles or a compared command sequence can observe; the effect is visible only in LTTng trace event payloads, which the fuzzer cannot capture. No scenario can reach the change.
